page.overview:
Who is Albert Speer?

During the last days of the second World War, Speer went to Berlin to participate at a meeting in the Führerbunker, where he discussed with the other officials about the fate of Berlin, due to the forward moving Allied Forces and the death of Roosevelt, in which his superior, Adolf Hitler, presented the Ancient Spear of Destiny, with whom he planned to defeat not only the Allies, but also the whole world.

Following that, Speer went back to his ministry.
